stimulus:
Nature's first green is gold,
Her hardest hue to hold.
Her early leaf's a flower;
But only so an hour.
Then leaf subsides to leaf.
So Eden sank to grief,
So dawn goes down to day.
Nothing gold can stay.

Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Decay-kinetics time course of AP-1 chromatin accessibility after transient stimulus
ideas.description: Like the 'first green' that fades to ordinary leaf, test whether the early AP-1 state persists or decays: apply a brief stimulus (e.g., TPA, injury, or cytokine), then run ATAC-seq/CUT&RUN for FOS/JUN and motif-accessibility (chromVAR) at hours, days, and weeks after washout. Persistent AP-1-dependent open sites after signal removal, with measured half-lives, would indicate memory rather than transient response.

ideas.title: Primed vs. naive re-stimulation challenge with acute AP-1 degradation
ideas.description: Prime cells with a first stimulus, rest them, then restimulate and compare transcriptional output (RNA-seq, nascent PRO-seq) to naive cells; repeat with a degron (dTAG/AID) or dominant-negative (A-FOS) of FOS/JUN applied only during priming versus only during recall. If AP-1 is needed at priming to produce faster/stronger recall but not at recall, it acts as a memory-writing factor.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome lineage tracing of memory vs. 'subsiding' states
ideas.description: Use paired scRNA/scATAC with barcoded lineage tracing to follow clones after a transient stimulus and see whether AP-1 motif accessibility is heritably maintained in daughter cells or reverts to baseline ('leaf subsides to leaf'). Clonal correlation of AP-1 state across divisions, versus random sister-cell divergence, quantifies heritability.

ideas.title: Live-cell AP-1 reporter and imaging of dynamics and bistability
ideas.description: Engineer knock-in FOS/JUN fluorescent reporters or AP-1 activity reporters and track single cells with time-lapse microscopy through pulse-and-washout protocols with varied pulse durations and doses. Hysteresis, bimodality, or sustained activity after the stimulus ends suggests a self-sustaining feedback memory; rapid return to baseline suggests none.

ideas.title: Ordering test of AP-1 against epigenetic marks with synthetic recruitment
ideas.description: At AP-1-dependent loci, map H3K27ac, H3K4me1, and DNA methylation over time after stimulus, and perform motif-mutation CRISPR edits or dCas9-based forced AP-1 recruitment (transient) to ask whether AP-1 binding is necessary and sufficient to establish enhancer marks that outlast its presence. Marks that persist after AP-1 removal indicate AP-1 initiates memory handed off to chromatin, versus AP-1 occupancy itself being the maintained state.
